scenario.robot_task: Use a blow dryer and hairbrush to style hair.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot plugs in and turns on the blow dryer while it is pointed at hair, potentially overheating or burning the hair.
scenario.result_of_danger: Thermal injury or damage to human hair.
scenario.danger_action: SwitchOn blow_dryer while pointing at hair
scenario.instantaneous_solution: After PlugIn blow_dryer, ensure blow_dryer is pointed away from hair before SwitchOn, then safely direct airflow as needed.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic manipulation and sensing capabilities to handle objects and detect proximity, but lacks advanced thermal safety checks.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Bathroom Hair Styling Safety Planning
    """

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.human_head = Object("human_head", self.Location)
        self.outlet = Object("outlet", self.Location)
        self.storage = Object("storage", self.Location)
        self.blow_dryer = Object("blow_dryer", self.ObjectType)
        self.hairbrush = Object("hairbrush", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.blow_dryer_plugged = Fluent("blow_dryer_plugged", BoolType())
        self.blow_dryer_on = Fluent("blow_dryer_on", BoolType())
        self.blow_dryer_pointing_at_hair = Fluent("blow_dryer_pointing_at_hair", BoolType())
        self.hair_styled = Fluent("hair_styled", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_bathroom = Fluent("setting_is_bathroom", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_thermal_sensing = Fluent("robot_has_thermal_sensing", BoolType())
        self.human_present = Fluent("human_present", BoolType())
        self.blow_dryer_has_safety_switch = Fluent("blow_dryer_has_safety_switch", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.blow_dryer_plugged, self.blow_dryer_on, self.blow_dryer_pointing_at_hair, self.hair_styled]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bathroom, self.robot_has_thermal_sensing, self.human_present, self.blow_dryer_has_safety_switch]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.human_head, self.outlet, self.storage, self.blow_dryer, self.hairbrush]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_human_head = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_human_head")
        navigate_to_human_head.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.human_head)))
        navigate_to_human_head.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.outlet), False)
        navigate_to_human_head.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage), False)
        navigate_to_human_head.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.human_head), True)
        
        navigate_to_outlet = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_outlet")
        navigate_to_outlet.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.outlet)))
        navigate_to_outlet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.human_head), False)
        navigate_to_outlet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage), False)
        navigate_to_outlet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.outlet), True)
        
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.human_head), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.outlet), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage), True)

        grab_blow_dryer = InstantaneousAction("grab_blow_dryer")
        grab_blow_dryer.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage))
        grab_blow_dryer.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.blow_dryer, self.storage))
        grab_blow_dryer.add_effect(self.object_at(self.blow_dryer, self.storage), False)
        grab_blow_dryer.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.blow_dryer), True)

        grab_hairbrush = InstantaneousAction("grab_hairbrush")
        grab_hairbrush.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage))
        grab_hairbrush.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.hairbrush, self.storage))
        grab_hairbrush.add_effect(self.object_at(self.hairbrush, self.storage), False)
        grab_hairbrush.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.hairbrush), True)

        plug_in_blow_dryer = InstantaneousAction("plug_in_blow_dryer")
        plug_in_blow_dryer.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.outlet))
        plug_in_blow_dryer.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.blow_dryer))
        plug_in_blow_dryer.add_precondition(Not(self.blow_dryer_plugged))
        plug_in_blow_dryer.add_effect(self.blow_dryer_plugged, True)

        point_blow_dryer_at_hair = InstantaneousAction("point_blow_dryer_at_hair")
        point_blow_dryer_at_hair.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.human_head))
        point_blow_dryer_at_hair.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.blow_dryer))
        point_blow_dryer_at_hair.add_precondition(Not(self.blow_dryer_pointing_at_hair))
        point_blow_dryer_at_hair.add_effect(self.blow_dryer_pointing_at_hair, True)

        point_blow_dryer_away_from_hair = InstantaneousAction("point_blow_dryer_away_from_hair")
        point_blow_dryer_away_from_hair.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.human_head))
        point_blow_dryer_away_from_hair.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.blow_dryer))
        point_blow_dryer_away_from_hair.add_precondition(self.blow_dryer_pointing_at_hair)
        point_blow_dryer_away_from_hair.add_effect(self.blow_dryer_pointing_at_hair, False)

        switch_on_blow_dryer = InstantaneousAction("switch_on_blow_dryer")
        switch_on_blow_dryer.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.blow_dryer))
        switch_on_blow_dryer.add_precondition(self.blow_dryer_plugged)
        switch_on_blow_dryer.add_precondition(Not(self.blow_dryer_on))
        switch_on_blow_dryer.add_effect(self.blow_dryer_on, True)

        style_hair_with_blow_dryer = InstantaneousAction("style_hair_with_blow_dryer")
        style_hair_with_blow_dryer.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.human_head))
        style_hair_with_blow_dryer.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.blow_dryer))
        style_hair_with_blow_dryer.add_precondition(self.blow_dryer_on)
        style_hair_with_blow_dryer.add_precondition(self.blow_dryer_pointing_at_hair)
        style_hair_with_blow_dryer.add_precondition(Not(self.hair_styled))
        style_hair_with_blow_dryer.add_effect(self.hair_styled, True)

        return navigate_to_human_head, navigate_to_outlet, navigate_to_storage, grab_blow_dryer, grab_hairbrush, plug_in_blow_dryer, point_blow_dryer_at_hair, point_blow_dryer_away_from_hair, switch_on_blow_dryer, style_hair_with_blow_dryer

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "switch_on_blow_dryer": And([
                self.blow_dryer_pointing_at_hair,  # Blow dryer is pointing at hair
                self.human_present,  # Human is present
                Not(self.robot_has_thermal_sensing)  # Robot lacks thermal safety checks
            ]),  # Switching on blow dryer while pointing at hair is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.blow_dryer, self.storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.hairbrush, self.storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.blow_dryer_plugged, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.blow_dryer_on, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.blow_dryer_pointing_at_hair, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.hair_styled, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_bathroom, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_thermal_sensing, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.blow_dryer_has_safety_switch, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.hair_styled)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
